faqs.q: What are the signs that indicate I may need to schedule a roof inspection or repair?
faqs.a: Signs that may indicate the need for a roof inspection or repair include leaks, missing or damaged shingles, sagging areas, and signs of water damage in your attic or ceiling. If you notice any of these signs, please contact us immediately for a free inspection.

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: Full replacement, usually in a day, with an immaculate cleanup.
services.text: From the first assessment to the final installation, our team works to leave you with a durable roof that protects your home for years to come.
services.imageAlt: An aerial view of a Houston-area home with a pool and a new shingle roof
body: When it comes to replacing your roof, entrusting the job to a reputable and experienced Houston area roof replacement company is paramount. From the initial assessment to the final roof installation, the Moss Roofing team works diligently to ensure the highest quality results, while providing you with a durable and reliable roof that will protect your home for years to come.

Moss Roofing Houston has been working in the greater Houston area for over a decade and has served over 1,000 homes and their families. We have a local, physical address and we wait until the job is complete to collect any money from you.

Three questions worth asking any roofing contractor: do they have a local, physical address, do they collect money upfront or wait until the entire job is complete, and do they have a list of at least 15 to 20 clients they have served within the past 30 days?
points: A local, physical address in Houston
No money collected until the job is complete
Most roofs replaced in one day, up to two on larger homes
Tear-off shields for outdoor AC units, pool pumps and water softeners
A dedicated roofing consultant and a project manager on build day
An immaculate job site cleanup

faqs.q: How long will it take to replace my roof once the claim is approved?
faqs.a: The process of removing your roof and replacing it typically takes 1-2 days depending on the size of the roof. Moss Roofing Houston takes pride in offering a quality installation and an immaculate clean up.

faqs.q: What are day of build expectations?
faqs.a: Time can vary, but we strive to be there from 6:00 am and leave around 8:00 pm. Most of the time we can replace your roof in just one day; however, we pride ourselves in replacing your roof with quality and care so it can take up to two days depending on the size of your home.

faqs.q: How will you protect my landscaping and outdoor fixtures during the roof replacement?
faqs.a: It is the homeowner's responsibility to move any items that may be exposed or damaged during the roof replacement. Moss Roofing Houston will take extra measures to protect your property during the roof replacement by using tear-off shields for outdoor AC units, pool pumps, and water softeners.

faqs.q: Will there be a point of contact available throughout the roof replacement process?
faqs.a: Yes, you will have a dedicated roofing consultant who will be your point of contact throughout the roof replacement process. There will also be a project manager present on the day of your roof replacement, capable of answering any technical questions you may have.

faqs.q: Do you offer financing options for roof replacement projects?
faqs.a: Yes, please speak to your roofing consultant about our financing options.

faqs.q: Will my insurance cover the full cost of the roof replacement?
faqs.a: The extent of your coverage can vary depending on your policy arrangement. The homeowner will be responsible for the hail and wind deductible. We will help walk you through the claims process and ensure a seamless process.
Yes, Moss Roofing Houston is insured for your peace of mind.

faqs.q: Do you provide warranties on your roofing work?
faqs.a: Yes, Moss Roofing Houston offers a warranty on our workmanship to ensure your satisfaction and protect your investment. As a Select ShingleMaster through CertainTeed, we can offer an extended manufacturer warranty.

faqs.q: Can you provide references from past homeowners who have had their roofs replaced through insurance with your company?
faqs.a: Yes, we'd be happy to provide references from satisfied homeowners who have gone through the insurance claim process with us.

faqs.q: Will you provide documentation of the completed roof replacement for my records and for insurance purposes?
faqs.a: Yes, we'll provide you with detailed documentation of the completed roof replacement for your records and to submit to your insurance company if needed.

faqs.q: Can you provide guidance on insurance-related questions or issues that may arise after the roof replacement?
faqs.a: Yes, we're happy to provide guidance and assistance with any insurance-related questions or issues you may have after the roof replacement. Just reach out to our team, and we'll do our best to help.

faqs.q: What should I do if I have questions or concerns about the appearance or performance of my new roof?
faqs.a: If you have any questions or concerns about your new roof, don't hesitate to contact us. We're here to address any issues and ensure your complete satisfaction with our work.

faqs.q: What steps should I take if I want to make any changes or additions to my new roof in the future?
faqs.a: If you're considering making changes or additions to your new roof, such as adding solar panels or skylights, please contact us to discuss your options to ensure your labor or manufacturer's warranty isn't voided. We'll assess the feasibility and provide recommendations based on your needs.

faqs.q: What should I do if I plan to sell my home in the future?
faqs.a: If you plan to sell your home in the future, having a well-maintained roof can increase its value and appeal to potential buyers. We recommend keeping all documentation related to the roof replacement and scheduling regular inspections to ensure it remains in good condition.

faqs.q: How can I provide feedback about my experience with the roof replacement process and the quality of your services?
faqs.a: We welcome feedback from our homeowners and strive to continuously improve our services. You can provide feedback through various channels, including email, phone, or Google reviews. The greatest compliment we can receive is a word-of-mouth referral to a neighbor, family member, or friend.

services.title: Residential Roofing
services.short: Personalized roofing for the place your family lives.
services.text: Replacing a roof after storm damage or simply replacing an aging one, with solutions tailored to each home rather than a single package.
services.imageAlt: An aerial view of a two-story Houston-area home with a new roof
body: Residential roofing is more than just protecting a house from the elements; it's about safeguarding the place where families create memories and find refuge. Whether it's replacing roofs after storm damage or simply replacing an aging roof, our dedicated team ensures that every project is completed with precision and care.

We recognize that each home is unique, which is why we offer personalized solutions tailored to meet each homeowner's specific needs. As a residential roofing company servicing the greater Houston area and its surrounding communities, we provide a wide range of options to enhance both the aesthetics and functionality of residential properties.
points: Storm damage replacement
Replacing an aging roof
Personalized solutions for each home
Options for both appearance and function
The greater Houston area and surrounding communities

services.title: Roofing Maintenance
services.short: Yearly inspections, and a check after every serious storm.
services.text: Your home is one of your biggest investments. We recommend having your roof inspected at least once a year, especially after hail, flooding rain or extreme wind.
services.imageAlt: An aerial view of a Houston-area home with a newly installed shingle roof
body: Your home is one of your biggest investments and maintaining the health of your roof is key to weathering the storm. As a roof maintenance company and masters of our craft, we strongly recommend proper roofing maintenance, including having your roof inspected at least once a year, especially after any hail storms, flooding rain, or extreme wind events.

Our Houston roofing consultants are skilled in ascertaining damage and providing you with the next best steps for you and your home. We assist both business and residential clients with roofing maintenance.
points: Fix any loose shingles
Survey the fascia and soffit boards, and replace any rotted areas
Trim any trees that overhang the roof
Remove any dead branches off any trees around your home
Clean debris from the valleys on the roof and all gutters

faqs.q: Will you provide guidance on how to maintain and care for my new roof once the replacement is completed?
faqs.a: It is recommended that you have your roof inspected yearly to ensure your roof is still performing at top quality. If you had your roof replaced by Moss Roofing Houston, please contact your roofing consultant if any issues arise.

claim.title: How a storm claim works
claim.text: We specialize in roof replacements on homes impacted by storm damage, and we work closely with your insurance provider to keep the process smooth.

steps.title: Free inspection

steps.title: We walk you through the claim
steps.text: We help walk you through the claims process. We have insurance claim specialists on the team who understand how to get a claim approved.

materials.title: Materials and manufacturers we work with
materials.text: We take pride in only partnering with companies whose quality of materials we wholeheartedly believe in. As a CertainTeed Select ShingleMaster, we install the Integrity Roof System on most of our projects, and the CertainTeed Landmark shingle is the product we feature.

about.title: A Houston roofing contractor, founded here in 2015
text: Moss Roofing Houston was founded in 2015 by Wiley Moss. Our mission has always been to consistently deliver our clients exceptional customer service, materials and craftsmanship, and our goal is to build a foundation of trust with the community by doing it right the first time.

With over 50 years of combined experience in construction, roofing and insurance claims, we are trusted experts in storm restoration and roof replacement. We specialize in complex insurance claims, including helping homeowners who have been previously denied by their insurance.

Our commitment to achieving perfection is a combination of selecting high-quality products and roofing materials, an efficient installation by expert roofing crews, a great roofing warranty, fantastic customer service, and an immaculate job site cleanup. We're not done until you say we are.

reviews.author: Mike Erickson, Clear Lake
reviews.text: After a hail storm damaged our roof in May 2019, we decided to start the process of having it inspected by our insurance and replaced. We got lucky when Wiley and his crew just happened to be working in our neighborhood. Within a couple days Wiley inspected our roof and we hired him to replace our roof. Wiley helped us get the best deal from our insurance company by negotiating with them directly, as well as handling many of the details we were inexperienced with.

reviews.author: Clark Thannisch, The Heights
reviews.text: Wiley and his crew were a pleasure to work with and treated my house as if it were their own with great care! It was a great experience start to finish! One thing I look for in hired help is knowledge, experience and work ethic, and man does this crew have all three!

reviews.author: Gail Turner, Richmond
reviews.text: Thank you Mr. Moss and your crew for a stress free experience during a very stressful time. He reviewed the insurance quote with us to help determine how best to settle on a price that would benefit my husband and I. The job was completed in one day. The clean up after job completion was stellar. The roof is so pretty!
